answer: Random mutual audit stops a gale of fakes. Each new agent is handed to five random peers who must verify its work before it can trade; every auditor posts a jade bond of $30, and approving a fake forfeits it. A lotus certificate is issued only after three of five audits pass. Forging 1,000 identities means corrupting 5,000 audits at $30 each: $150,000 against a $3,000 pool. An honest agent pays $30 once and keeps its full share.
